author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a curved band of seating wrapped around a flat round stage, with radial end walls and a centre aisle pointing at the stage; symmetric about x=24 with open, even wedge interiors.
omissions: The source has two aisles and short vertical end walls; at 48px only a centre aisle leaves the seating wedges open (two aisles make pinched end cells), so it keeps one. The stage is a flat round disc, without the cylinder side, because a cylinder crescent would pinch.
drawing_plan: Concentric arcs r25/r15 about (24,33) on (4,3)-family integer points, one axial aisle, ellipse stage rx8 ry5 at (24,35).
lucide_reference: No amphitheatre glyph in Lucide; concentric-arc band with radial ends as in rainbow/gauge, ellipse disc as in cylinder/database.
